title: The circuit of the test city can be driven (test_world_api: the route test_loop)

accept.name: test_world_api passes, every leg of test_loop has a way
test_loop stays a 2-lap race with a gate on the elevated road and its grid
accept.cmd: python -c "import json; c=json.load(open('data/city/test_city.json',encoding='utf-8')); r=[x for x in c['routes'] if x['id']=='test_loop'][0]; ok=r['kind']=='race' and r['laps']==2 and len(r['checkpoints'])>=4 and any(p[1]>=8 for p in r['checkpoints']) and r['grid']==[-450,0,-5,90]; print('TEST_LOOP_SHAPE OK' if ok else 'TEST_LOOP_SHAPE FAIL')"

accept.name: the race runs on the roads of the test city (no road drawn over another, links joined at junctions)
